message: Astra: Could we set aside the unresolved carry-forward fidelity correction and keep this meeting moving through Alice's question, "Have any of you considered the potential communication bottlenecks between parallel tasks?", by choosing its next dramatic consequence, not yet verified? What does her new question reveal about her relationship with the others that their earlier agreement did not? Would further thought about their competing priorities be worth its time versus drafting the next exchange now, and what uncertainty would make waiting more valuable? What evidence in your draft would justify either choice, and which next step will you carry out?
